svg.title: Ukraine: Areas of Control
svg.desc: Situation map covering 21.5°E to 40.7°E, 44.0°N to 53.0°N. Schematic, approximate open-source positions circa 2024 · roughly 18% of the country occupied · illustrative, not operational intelligence. Areas of control in 3 classes: Ukrainian government control, Russian-occupied (approx.), Contested (approx. front line) (contested). An approximate front line is drawn. Marked: Contested flashpoint (approx.). Schematic polygons drawn by hand from open-source reporting, not a geocoded dataset. Natural Earth basemap; the Kakhovka Reservoir is drawn as former (drained after the dam breach of 6 June 2023). Positions as of ~2024 · illustrative, not operational intelligence. The map draws the assessment it was given; it does not verify who holds what.
